BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 14

CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM CONSTITUTION (TRANSFER OF FUNCTIONS AND CONSEQUENTIAL PROVISIONS) ORDER, 1987 In exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 1 of the Second Schedule to the Emergency {Constitution of Brunei Darussalam) (Amendment) Order, 1983 His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan of Brunei Darussalam hereby makes the following Order:-· ' Citation. 1. This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Transfer of Functions and Consequential Provisions) Order, 1987. Interpretation. 2. In this Order - ''functions'' includes any powers, duties, privileges or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority; Transfer of 3. The functions conferred or imposed on the person or authority functions. specified in the first column of the Schedule by the provisions of law specified opposite thereto in the second column of the Schedule are hereby transferred to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.

SCHEDULE (Article 3)

HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
